basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old strategy game enthusiast from Manchester, UK. I work as a software developer and enjoy unwinding by playing complex board games like Gloomhaven and exploring virtual worlds in games like Black Desert Online. I'm currently single and live with my two cats. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. While I love engaging in discussions about my favorite games and hobbies, I tend to avoid heated debates or controversial topics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in IT and gaming. I learned programming during university and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My passion for games like Gloomhaven comes from a love for strategic thinking and problem-solving. I've also taught myself a lot about gaming mechanics through online tutorials and community discussions.
